tasks.answer: The flight-delay-compensation batch workspace page component is `FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen`, the named export of src/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen.tsx. It is rendered by the route /flight-delay-compensation/batches/$batchId (src/pages/flight-delay-compensation/batches/$batchId.tsx) with a single required prop `batchId: string`. It composes the batch-workspace step components and the useFlightDelayCompensationBatchWorkspace hook.

The special-traveler booking list component is `TravelerBookingListScreen`, a named export of src/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen.tsx. Required prop: `navigate: (options: NavigateOptions) => void | Promise<void>`; `initialStatus?: number` is optional. The page src/pages/traveler-bookings/index.tsx passes both.

`PasswordInput` is the default export of src/features/auth/password-input.tsx. Its only own prop is `error?: string` (required props: none; hideLabel/showLabel are supplied internally). Errors are shown through the wrapping `UiFormField`: when `error != null` it renders an antd-mobile Form.Item description as `<span role="alert" class="ui-form-field__error">` (danger-colored, 12px text) directly under the field, and `error !== undefined` is also passed to `UiPasswordInput` so UiInput adds the `ui-input--error` class (danger border/text) and `aria-invalid`.

The mobile booking list uses `SearchBar` and `FilterSheet`, both named exports of src/components/business/mobile.tsx. `SearchBar` requires `value: string`, `placeholder: string`, `onChange: (value: string) => void` (`onFilter?` is optional). `FilterSheet` requires `visible: boolean`, `title: ReactNode`, `children: ReactNode`, `onClose: () => void` (`onReset?` and `onConfirm?` are optional). booking-list-screen.tsx imports both and controls filter visibility with local state.

The global authentication-recovery dialog is `AuthRecoveryDialog`, a named export of src/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog.tsx. It takes no props and is mounted once globally in src/App.tsx (line 131) inside ThemeProvider > LangProvider > UiProvider > QueryClientProvider, next to NotificationStreamListener and above RouterProvider. It subscribes to the external auth-recovery store via useSyncExternalStore, returns null when there is no event, and when an event exists lazily loads `AuthRecoveryDialogView` (UiDialog) inside Suspense; the view offers retry/reload or re-login actions.
